mapper.sql: FROM ( SELECT v.task_id,v.target_type,v.target_id,v.created_at AS submitted_at,v.state AS review_state FROM content_safety_review v UNION ALL SELECT MIN(r.id) AS task_id,r.target_type,r.target_id,MIN(r.created_at) AS submitted_at,NULL AS review_state FROM content_audit_log r WHERE r.audit_source=1 AND r.wx_result=1 AND r.final_result=2 AND r.target_type IN (1,2,4) AND r.review_task_id IS NULL GROUP BY r.target_type,r.target_id ) review JOIN content_audit_log machine ON machine.id = review.task_id LEFT JOIN content_safety_review versioned ON versioned.task_id=review.task_id JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS target_type, p.id AS target_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.title, ''), CONCAT('帖子 #', p.id)) AS title, p.content, p.user_id AS author_id, p.status AS target_status, 'POST' AS resource_namespace, NULL AS parent_id, NULL AS image_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.target_type = 1 AND r.target_id = p.id AND r.status = 0) AS report_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_attachment ma WHERE ma.target_type = 1 AND ma.target_id = p.id) AS attachment_count FROM post p UNION ALL SELECT 2, a.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.title, ''), CONCAT('活动 #', a.id)), a.summary, a.user_id, a.publish_status, 'ACTIVITY', NULL, NULL, 0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_attachment ma WHERE ma.target_type = 2 AND ma.target_id = a.id) FROM activity a UNION ALL SELECT 4, c.id, CONCAT('评论 #', c.id), c.content, c.user_id, c.status, CASE c.target_type WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post cp WHERE cp.id = c.target_id) THEN 'POST' END WHEN 2 THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity ca WHERE ca.id = c.target_id) THEN 'ACTIVITY' END WHEN 3 THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public_event ce WHERE ce.id = c.target_id) THEN 'PUBLIC_EVENT' END WHEN 8 THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article cr WHERE cr.id = c.target_id) THEN 'ARTICLE' END END, c.parent_id, c.image_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.target_type = 4 AND r.target_id = c.id AND r.status = 0), IF(c.image_url IS NULL OR c.image_url = '', 0, 1) FROM comment c ) target ON target.target_type = review.target_type AND target.target_id = review.target_id LEFT JOIN user_profile author ON author.id = target.author_id LEFT JOIN content_audit_log manual_audit ON manual_audit.id = ( SELECT MAX(m.id) FROM content_audit_log m WHERE ((m.review_task_id=review.task_id) OR (review.review_state IS NULL AND m.review_task_id IS NULL AND m.target_type=review.target_type AND m.target_id=review.target_id)) AND m.audit_source = 2 AND m.admin_action IN (1, 2) )

review.review_state='pending' AND versioned.task_id IS NOT NULL AND ( (review.target_type=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post live WHERE live.id=review.target_id AND live.deleted_at IS NULL AND live.status IN (1,2) AND live.revision=versioned.business_revision)) OR (review.target_type=4 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment live WHERE live.id=review.target_id AND live.deleted_at IS NULL AND live.status=0 AND (live.parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment root WHERE root.id=live.parent_id AND root.status=1 AND root.deleted_at IS NULL AND root.target_type=live.target_type AND root.target_id=live.target_id)) AND ((live.target_type=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post parent WHERE parent.id=live.target_id AND parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND parent.status=2)) OR (live.target_type=2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activity parent WHERE parent.id=live.target_id AND parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND parent.publish_status=1)) OR (live.target_type=3 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public_event parent WHERE parent.id=live.target_id AND parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND parent.publish_status=1))))))

WHERE 1 = 1
AND review.target_type = #{targetType}
AND (
target.target_id = #{keywordId} OR
COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_title,target.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_content,'') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ()
AND (review.review_state IN ('approved','rejected') OR manual_audit.id IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE(versioned.decided_at,manual_audit.created_at) >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) AND COALESCE(versioned.decided_at,manual_audit.created_at) < DATE_ADD(DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

AND (
target.target_id = #{keywordId} OR
COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_title,target.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_content,'') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ()
AND (review.review_state IN ('approved','rejected') OR manual_audit.id IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE(versioned.decided_at,manual_audit.created_at) >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) AND COALESCE(versioned.decided_at,manual_audit.created_at) < DATE_ADD(DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT review.task_id, review.target_type, review.target_id, COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_title,target.title) AS title, COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_content,'') AS content, target.author_id, COALESCE(author.nickname, CONCAT('用户 #', target.author_id)) AS author_name, author.avatar_url, author.role AS author_role, author.status AS author_status, author.created_at AS author_created_at, target.image_url, target.target_status, target.parent_id, target.report_count, target.attachment_count, machine.wx_trace_id, machine.wx_detail, review.submitted_at, manual_audit.id AS manual_log_id, manual_audit.final_result AS manual_result, manual_audit.admin_user_id, manual_audit.admin_remark, manual_audit.created_at AS manual_created_at
AND (review.submitted_at < #{cursorSubmittedAt} OR (review.submitted_at = #{cursorSubmittedAt} AND review.task_id < #{cursorTaskId}))
AND (review.submitted_at > #{cursorSubmittedAt} OR (review.submitted_at = #{cursorSubmittedAt} AND review.task_id > #{cursorTaskId}))
ORDER BY review.submitted_at DESC, review.task_id DESC
ORDER BY review.submitted_at ASC, review.task_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT review.task_id, review.target_type, review.target_id, COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_title,target.title) AS title, COALESCE(versioned.snapshot_content,'') AS content, target.author_id, COALESCE(author.nickname, CONCAT('用户 #', target.author_id)) AS author_name, author.avatar_url, author.role AS author_role, author.status AS author_status, author.created_at AS author_created_at, target.image_url, target.target_status, target.parent_id, target.report_count, target.attachment_count, machine.wx_trace_id, machine.wx_detail, review.submitted_at, manual_audit.id AS manual_log_id, manual_audit.final_result AS manual_result, manual_audit.admin_user_id, manual_audit.admin_remark, manual_audit.created_at AS manual_created_at
AND (review.submitted_at < #{cursorSubmittedAt} OR (review.submitted_at = #{cursorSubmittedAt} AND review.task_id < #{cursorTaskId}))
AND (review.submitted_at > #{cursorSubmittedAt} OR (review.submitted_at = #{cursorSubmittedAt} AND review.task_id > #{cursorTaskId}))
ORDER BY review.submitted_at DESC, review.task_id DESC
ORDER BY review.submitted_at ASC, review.task_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(versioned.decided_at,manual_audit.created_at) >= #{dayStart} AND COALESCE(versioned.decided_at,manual_audit.created_at) < #{dayEnd}), 0) AS today_completed, MIN(CASE WHEN () THEN review.submitted_at END) AS oldest_pending_at
WHERE 1 = 1

WHERE review.task_id = #{taskId} AND target.resource_namespace IS NOT NULL AND target.resource_namespace != 'ARTICLE'

SELECT id, review_task_id, target_type, target_id, audit_source, wx_trace_id, wx_result, wx_detail, admin_user_id, admin_action, admin_remark, idempotency_key, final_result, created_at FROM content_audit_log WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, target_type, target_id, audit_source, wx_result, final_result, created_at FROM content_audit_log WHERE id = #{taskId} AND audit_source = 1 AND wx_result = 1 AND final_result = 2 FOR UPDATE
SELECT MIN(id) FROM content_audit_log WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND audit_source = 1 AND wx_result = 1 AND final_result = 2

SELECT id, review_task_id, target_type, target_id, audit_source, admin_user_id, admin_action, admin_remark, idempotency_key, final_result, created_at FROM content_audit_log WHERE audit_source = 2 AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
